# Rocky Mountain Kids Dentistry

> > A pediatric dental practice in Englewood, CO providing comprehensive dental care for children with a focus on preventive wellness, emergency care, and specialized treatment for special healthcare needs.

Rocky Mountain Kids Dentistry is a pediatric dental practice serving the Denver metro area including Englewood, Littleton, Greenwood Village, and Cherry Hills Village. The practice is led by experienced pediatric dentists including Dr. Lane Bland, Dr. Carissa Molina, and Dr. Heather Jenkins, and offers evidence-based preventive and restorative dental care for children of all ages and abilities.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Preventive Dental Wellness
- Emergency Dental Care
- Dental Restorations
- Cavity Prevention
- Special Healthcare Needs
- Fluoride Treatments
- Dental Sealants

- Englewood, Colorado
- New Patients Welcome
- Nitrous Oxide Sedation

## Core Services

- [Services](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/services): Overview of pediatric dental services offered by Rocky Mountain Kids
- [Dental Wellness](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/dental-wellness): Preventive dental wellness services for children at Rocky Mountain Kids
- [Emergency Dental Care](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/emergency-dental-care): Emergency dental care for traumatic injuries and tooth pain in kids
- [Special Healthcare Needs](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/special-healthcare-needs): Specialized dental care for children with special healthcare needs

## Preventive & Protective Treatments

- [Fluoride Treatments for Kids](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/fluoride-treatments): Fluoride treatments for cavity prevention in children's dentistry
- [Dental Sealants for Kids](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/sealants): Dental sealants to reduce cavity risk by up to 80% for children
- [Sports Guards](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/sports-guards): Custom sports guards and mouthguards for children's athletic safety
- [Low-Radiation Digital X-Rays](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/low-radiation-digital-dental-x-rays): Low-radiation digital X-ray technology for pediatric dental care

## Restorative Treatments

- [Dental Restorations](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/dental-restorations): Dental restoration services including fillings and crowns for kids
- [Tooth Colored Fillings](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/tooth-colored-fillings): Aesthetic tooth-colored fillings for cavity treatment in children
- [Biocompatible Stainless Steel Crowns](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/biocompatible-stainless-steel-crowns): Stainless steel and zirconia crowns for baby tooth restoration
- [Bondings](https://rockymountainkidsdentistry.com/englewood-co/bondings): Dental bonding with composite resin for tooth repair in children
